rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING LABOR SECTOR REPRESENTATION IN THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF THE WELFARE FUND FOR OVERSEAS CONTRACT WORKERS AND PROVIDING FOR THE QUALIFICATION OF SUCH REPRESENTATIVES , AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED SIXTEEN HUNDRED AND NINETY-FOUR, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: Provides  for THREE (3) REPRESENTATIVES for the labor sector to sit in the WELFUND'S Board of Trustees; allows these representatives to  serve for a   term of   two   (2) years without reappointment. Requires the representatives to have at least two(2) years experience as overseas contract workers  and must  belong to duly accredited organizations of overseas contract workers. * * *
